summary: Completed frontend testing of BRUNO app bug fixes and new features. All requested features verified working: 1) Dropdown selector for card type in CreateCardPage, 2) New 'Mascotas/Pets' card type with all specific fields, 3) ViewCardPage template bug fix verified (no duplicate buttons), 4) ImageEditor uses native input range sliders. Fixed EditCardPage to also use dropdown and include mascotas type.
critical_code_review_comments: ViewCardPage template bug fix verified - edge_actions code is now correctly separated from full_banner_bubble block
ImageEditor correctly uses native HTML input range elements for brightness/contrast sliders instead of shadcn Slider
CreateCardPage uses dropdown selector with all 7 card types including mascotas
Mascotas card type has all required fields: petName, species, breed, age, color, size, medicalInfo, ifLostTitle, reward, lostInstructions, ownerContacts
SocialLinkSelector form works correctly with type dropdown, URL input, and label fields
Translations for mascotas/pets are present in both ES and EN in LanguageContext.js
